corrections.old_text: ሙ ፡ በል ፡ ቍ ፡ ፰ ። ወብዙኅ ፡ ብየ ፡ በል ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ሙ ፡ በል ፡ ቍ ፡ ፲ ። ወብዙኅ ፡ ብየ ፡ በል ፡
corrections.reason: Both visually (single vertical stem matching ፲ in ፲፪ and ፲፫ on line 2) and philologically (the incipit 'ወዘኒ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ ኀቤክሙ' is 2 John verse 10, following verse 8 'ዑቁ ፡ ርእሰክሙ' at the end of the previous page), the numeral is ፲ (10), not ፰ (8).
The final character is 6th-order ት (with its characteristic lower-left serif), giving the canonical Ge'ez singular form መስሕት ('the deceiver', 2 John 1:7).
